preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of rooms n must be between 1 and 200,000, and the number of friends k must be less than n.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= x_i <= n for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: Each friend's room number x_i must be between 2 and n, and all x_i must be distinct.
The number of friends k must match the length of the list of room numbers x.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The total number of rooms across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if Vlad can guarantee a victory, otherwise 'NO'.
